about: Named Figma versions that a release points to. The snapshot records its own version id from now on (meta.figmaVersion). Versions saved before that were saved by title only: their id is read from the Figma version history, which needs a REST token for the account that owns the file.

versions.title: Colour roles
versions.content: Colour tokens named by role: 41 Semantic roles, 13 Context tokens, 262 variables. The content of release 1.1.0.

versions.title: Snapshot for Git
versions.content: First version saved and recorded by the snapshot itself (pipeline/01b). Pull request 2.
